title: NOMOS Key Certificate
description: A detached, Ed25519-signed statement that one key (the parent) certifies another key (the child) as authorized to sign, until an expiry (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §3). Chained together and resolved against a relying party's own pinned root, key certificates let an independent system recognize an artifact's issuer without a prior lookup or a call home.

parent_kid.description: Key id of the CERTIFYING key (a root or an intermediate), computed per NOMOS-SPEC-001 §8.4's convention.

child_kid.description: Key id of the key being certified. MUST equal computeKid(child_public_key_pem) — a verifier MUST NOT trust a child_kid that does not match the material carried in this same certificate.

child_public_key_pem.description: The certified key's own public key material, carried inline. There is no central directory to resolve it from — that absence is the entire point of a chain that verifies without calling home.

scope.description: Free-text in this version. Not yet a structurally enforced constraint (NOMOS-SPEC-007 §8.2) — carried so a future version can define enforcement without a wire-format break.

issued_at.description: When this statement was signed. Part of the signed payload.

expires_at.description: When this certificate stops being valid. Part of the signed payload.

signature.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over JCS({ parent_kid, child_kid, child_public_key_pem, scope, issued_at, expires_at }) — produced with the PARENT's private key. algorithm and signature itself are excluded from the signed payload.
